headline: Sarvam signs five-year AI MoU with HQ IDS for armed forces
quote: Sarvam AI has signed a five-year memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Defence to develop and deploy AI applications
claim: Sarvam signed a five-year MoU with HQ Integrated Defence Staff to develop AI applications for the Army, Navy and Air Force, to be run by its Chanakya division using the Sarvam 105B model; human oversight is retained for operational decisions.
why_it_matters: A homegrown lab's 105B model is now being tied into defence workflows, a sign of where sovereign-AI engineering jobs will be.
title: Sarvam Signs 5-Year Defence AI Deal Covering Army, Navy and

headline: Maharashtra rolls out Sarvam's Indus Cowork to 2,500 officials
quote: Sarvam AI's Indus Cowork is being rolled out to 2,500 Maharashtra government officials following its launch by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on October 28.
claim: Maharashtra launched Sarvam's Indus Cowork on 28 October for 2,500 officials under a two-year outlay of ₹11.26 crore, covering 22 languages including Marathi, plus Samvaad for citizen outreach.
why_it_matters: State governments are paying for Indian-language AI products at scale, which means real demand for people who can build and integrate them.
title: Maharashtra Government Adopts Sarvam AI Solutions

headline: L&T Vyoma.AI breaks ground on 52 MW Chennai data centre
quote: The company held a groundbreaking ceremony for the facility on October 28.
claim: Vyoma.AI, L&T's AI cloud unit, broke ground on 28 October on a 52 MW AI-ready data centre in Chennai with direct-to-chip liquid cooling, part of a plan for over 250 MW across India.
why_it_matters: More domestic GPU capacity means cheaper, in-country compute for Indian builders over time.
title: L&T’s Vyoma.AI Breaks Ground on 52 MW Data Centre in Chenna

headline: MeitY unveils DEPA for AI Training handbook with iSPIRT
quote: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan unveiled the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture (DEPA) for AI Training handbook at a roundtable in Bengaluru on 30 October.
claim: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan unveiled a draft DEPA for AI Training handbook, prepared with iSPIRT, proposing a 'sealed room' where models train on sensitive data without the raw data being shared.
why_it_matters: If adopted, it could open banking, health and education data for model training under consent rules, shaping what Indian AI builders can access.
title: DEPA for AI Training: MeitY's Plan to Unlock Data for AI | Elets CIO
